title: The Word Became Flesh, John the Baptist, The First Disciples

questions.question: According to the opening verse of the Gospel of John, what was in the beginning?
options: The Word
The Spirit
The Light
The Darkness
questions.explanation: John 1:1 (ESV): "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God."

questions.question: How were all things made, as stated in John 1:3?
options: Through him (the Word), and without him was not any thing made that was made
Through the angels that stood before the throne
Through the spoken breath of the prophets
By the physical shaping of the dust of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Through him (the Word), and without him was not any thing made that was made
questions.explanation: John 1:3 (ESV): "All things were made through him, and without him was not any thing made that was made."

questions.question: What did the Word become?
options: Flesh and dwelt among us
A spirit descending like a dove
A mighty wind blowing across the nations
A shining scroll written by God
questions.explanation: John 1:14 (ESV): "And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth."

questions.question: What did John the Baptist testify when he saw Jesus coming toward him?
options: "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!"
"Behold, the Lion of Judah has conquered!"
"Bow down before the true King of Israel!"
"Prepare yourselves, for judgment has arrived!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!"
questions.explanation: John 1:29 (ESV): "The next day he saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, 'Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!'"

questions.question: What did Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, tell Simon after he followed Jesus?
options: "We have found the Messiah" (which means Christ)
"We have seen Elijah returning from the wilderness"
"The prophet spoken of by Moses is teaching in the temple"
"A great rabbi is performing signs by the river"
questions.correctAnswer: "We have found the Messiah" (which means Christ)
questions.explanation: John 1:41 (ESV): "He first found his own brother Simon and said to him, 'We have found the Messiah' (which means Christ)."

questions.question: "There was a man sent from God, whose name was..."?
options: John
Elijah
Moses
Isaiah
questions.explanation: John 1:6 (ESV): "There was a man sent from God, whose name was John."

questions.question: He came to his own, and his own people did not receive him. What did he give to all who did receive him and believed in his name?
options: The right to become children of God
The keys to the kingdom of heaven perfectly
The assurance of earthly prosperity and peace
Ten multiplied talents of silver immediately
questions.correctAnswer: The right to become children of God
questions.explanation: John 1:11-12 (ESV): "He came to his own, and his own people did not receive him. But to all who did receive him, who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God,"

questions.question: The law was given through Moses; what came through Jesus Christ?
options: Grace and truth
Fire and iron
Vengeance and mercy
Righteousness and thunder
questions.explanation: John 1:17 (ESV): "For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ."

questions.question: When the priests and Levites asked John the Baptist "Are you the Prophet?", how did he answer?
options: "No."
"I am he."
"I am Elijah returning."
"I prepare his way only."
questions.explanation: John 1:21 (ESV): "And they asked him, 'What then? Are you Elijah?' He said, 'I am not.' 'Are you the Prophet?' And he answered, 'No.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say about Nathanael when He saw him coming toward Him?
options: "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no deceit!"
"He is a man of great faith completely."
"Why do you doubt the word of Philip?"
"Come, and I will make you a fisher of men."
questions.correctAnswer: "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no deceit!"
questions.explanation: John 1:47 (ESV): "Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said of him, 'Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no deceit!'"

questions.question: Which prophet did John the Baptist quote when asked who he was?
options: Isaiah ("I am the voice of one crying out in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord'")
Jeremiah ("I am a prophet to the nations")
Malachi ("I am the messenger pointing to the sun of righteousness")
Ezekiel ("I am the watchman upon the wall of the Lord")
questions.correctAnswer: Isaiah ("I am the voice of one crying out in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord'")
questions.explanation: John 1:23 (ESV): "He said, 'I am the voice of one crying out in the wilderness, "Make straight the way of the Lord," as the prophet Isaiah said.'"

questions.question: Why did John say he came baptizing with water?
options: "That he might be revealed to Israel"
"To wash away the original sin of the tribes"
"To replace the sacrifices made in the temple"
"That the wrath of God might be satisfied"
questions.correctAnswer: "That he might be revealed to Israel"
questions.explanation: John 1:31 (ESV): "I myself did not know him, but for this purpose I came baptizing with water, that he might be revealed to Israel."

questions.question: John testified he saw the Spirit descend from heaven like a dove. What was he told by the one who sent him to baptize about the person on whom the Spirit descends?
options: "He on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain, this is he who baptizes with the Holy Spirit."
"He will cleanse the temple within three days."
"This is the Son of God who will rule the nations with an iron rod."
"He is the word became flesh, dwelling among men."
questions.correctAnswer: "He on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain, this is he who baptizes with the Holy Spirit."
questions.explanation: John 1:33 (ESV): "I myself did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water said to me, 'He on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain, this is he who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.'"

questions.question: When Jesus looked at Simon, He said, "You are Simon the son of John. You shall be called Cephas." What does Cephas mean?
options: Peter (or Rock)
The Beloved
The Thunderer
The First
questions.explanation: John 1:42 (ESV): "Jesus looked at him and said, 'You are Simon the son of John. You shall be called Cephas' (which means Peter)."

questions.question: At the end of chapter 1, what did Jesus tell Nathanael he would see ascending and descending on the Son of Man?
options: The angels of God
A flaming chariot from heaven
The holy spirit like a dove
The stars of the heavens falling
questions.explanation: John 1:51 (ESV): "And he said to him, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.'"

key_verse_text: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
